svg.title: White Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Observed diagonal white band and its bottom/right contacts retained. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.glenstone.org/artworks/white-red; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
